requirements.title: Admin Configuration for Test Mobile Numbers
requirements.description: The system must allow an Admin to add one or more test mobile numbers via a configuration named 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers'.
requirements.source_excerpt: Admin can add one or more test mobile numbers.
constraints: Once saved, the numbers remain configured until manually removed.

requirements.title: Automated Customer Deletion Script
requirements.description: A shell script must be developed to delete Eyewear customer records for the configured mobile numbers and generate success/failure logs.
requirements.source_excerpt: Develop a shell script to delete Eyewear customer records for the configured mobile numbers. Generate success/failure logs.

requirements.title: Scheduled Cron Job Execution
requirements.description: A daily Cron job must execute at 12:30 AM to read configured mobile numbers and delete matching Eyewear customer records.
requirements.source_excerpt: Execute daily at 12:30 AM. Read configured mobile numbers from Admin. Delete matching Eyewear customer records.

requirements.title: Cron Job Error Handling
requirements.description: The Cron job must continue processing the remaining mobile numbers even if a single deletion fails.
requirements.source_excerpt: Continue processing remaining numbers even if one deletion fails.

requirements.title: SSO Data Isolation
requirements.description: The solution must only delete customer records from the Eyewear application, leaving Tata SSO identities and other Tata application data unchanged.
requirements.source_excerpt: This solution deletes customer records only from the Eyewear application. SSO identities and accounts in other Tata applications remain unchanged.
constraints: SSO identities and accounts in other Tata applications remain unchanged.

requirements.title: Usage Restriction
requirements.description: The feature is intended only for QA/testing and mobile numbers must be used only for login/signup testing.
requirements.source_excerpt: Feature is intended only for QA/testing. These numbers must be used only for login/signup testing.
constraints: Feature is intended only for QA/testing.
These numbers must be used only for login/signup testing.

requirements.title: Order Placement Restriction
requirements.description: No orders should be placed using the configured test mobile numbers to avoid data discrepancies.
requirements.source_excerpt: No orders should be placed using these numbers to avoid data discrepancies.
constraints: No orders should be placed using these numbers

business_rules.rule: The configuration for test mobile numbers must be named 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers'.
business_rules.source_excerpt: Add a configuration named 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers'.

business_rules.rule: Configured test mobile numbers must remain saved until manually removed.
business_rules.source_excerpt: Once saved, the numbers remain configured until manually removed.

business_rules.rule: The shell script must delete Eyewear customer records associated with configured mobile numbers.
business_rules.source_excerpt: Develop a shell script to delete Eyewear customer records for the configured mobile numbers.

business_rules.rule: The customer deletion script must generate success and failure logs.
The scheduled Cron job must execute daily at 12:30 AM.
Only configured test mobile numbers are eligible to be deleted.
business_rules.source_excerpt: Only configured mobile numbers are deleted.

business_rules.rule: Configured mobile numbers must be processed during every nightly Cron execution until removed from the Admin configuration.
business_rules.source_excerpt: Configured numbers are processed during every nightly Cron execution until removed from the Admin configuration.

business_rules.rule: The Cron job must continue processing remaining configured mobile numbers even if a deletion fails for one number.
business_rules.source_excerpt: Continue processing remaining numbers even if one deletion fails.

business_rules.rule: Customer record deletion must only affect data within the Eyewear application.
business_rules.source_excerpt: This solution deletes customer records only from the Eyewear application.

business_rules.rule: Tata SSO identities and accounts in other Tata applications must remain unchanged during customer deletion.
business_rules.source_excerpt: SSO identities and accounts in other Tata applications remain unchanged.

business_rules.rule: The test mobile cleanup feature must be used exclusively for QA and testing purposes.
business_rules.source_excerpt: Feature is intended only for QA/testing.

business_rules.rule: Configured test mobile numbers must be used exclusively for login and signup testing.
business_rules.source_excerpt: These numbers must be used only for login/signup testing.

business_rules.rule: No orders must be placed using configured test mobile numbers.
business_rules.source_excerpt: No orders should be placed using these numbers to avoid data discrepancies.

gaps.description: Validation rules for mobile numbers (such as accepted length, country code formatting, allowed character sets, and duplicate checking) are not defined.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the precise format, length, country code, and duplicate validation rules for test mobile numbers in the Admin UI?

gaps.description: The exact scope and strategy for customer record deletion (hard delete vs. soft delete, and treatment of child/linked records like carts, addresses, and auth tokens) are unspecified.
gaps.suggested_question: Is the deletion a hard database delete or soft delete, and what linked customer tables or entities must be cleaned up?

gaps.description: The timezone for the 12:30 AM scheduled Cron job execution is not specified.
gaps.suggested_question: Which specific timezone (e.g., UTC, IST) should be used to schedule the daily 12:30 AM Cron job execution?

gaps.description: Log storage location, log level details, retention policy, and accessibility for QA/Dev teams are not defined.
gaps.suggested_question: Where will the success/failure logs be stored, what information will each log entry contain, and how will QA access them?

gaps.description: Script behavior and error handling are undefined if a configured test mobile number has associated order records.
gaps.suggested_question: How should the script behave if an order was accidentally placed using a test mobile number: should deletion proceed, skip, or raise an error?

gaps.description: Notification mechanisms and failure alerting (e.g., email alerts, Slack webhooks, retry attempts) for failed deletions are unspecified.
gaps.suggested_question: Will there be any alerts generated or automatic retries attempted when a mobile number deletion fails during the Cron job run?

gaps.description: Dependency on SSO validation is left open and unresolved in the requirements text.
gaps.suggested_question: Has Engineering confirmed whether deleting only the Eyewear customer record successfully allows the mobile number to re-enter the signup flow without modifying Tata SSO?

scenarios.title: Admin Configuration of Test Mobile Numbers Persistence and Removal
scenarios.description: Verifies that an Admin can add one or more test mobile numbers under the 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers' configuration and that configured numbers persist until manually removed.

scenarios.title: Shell Script Execution and Customer Deletion Logging
scenarios.description: Verifies that the shell script deletes Eyewear customer records associated with configured mobile numbers and generates corresponding success and failure execution logs.

scenarios.title: Scheduled Nightly Cron Job Deletion Execution
scenarios.description: Verifies that the daily Cron job executes automatically at 12:30 AM to read configured test mobile numbers, delete matching Eyewear customer records, and process configured numbers nightly until they are removed.

scenarios.title: Cron Job Fault Tolerance on Record Deletion Failure
scenarios.description: Verifies that if deleting an Eyewear customer record fails for one mobile number, the Cron job logs the error and continues processing all remaining configured mobile numbers.

scenarios.title: Data Isolation between Eyewear Customer Records and Tata SSO Systems
scenarios.description: Verifies that customer deletion strictly targets data within the Eyewear application, leaving Tata SSO identities and accounts across other Tata applications unchanged.

scenarios.title: Validation of QA Login and Signup Usage for Test Mobile Numbers
scenarios.description: Verifies that configured test mobile numbers are used exclusively for QA login and signup testing, ensuring the cleanup workflow supports test account lifecycles.

scenarios.title: Restriction on Order Placement for Configured Test Mobile Numbers
scenarios.description: Verifies that no orders can be placed or exist for configured test mobile numbers to prevent data discrepancies in operational records.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify Admin configuration setup for adding test mobile numbers under Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers
test_cases.objective: Verify that an Admin user can access the 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers' configuration section and add a test mobile number.
preconditions: Admin user is authenticated and logged into the Admin Portal.
System configuration page for customer mobile number deletion is accessible.

steps.action: Navigate to System Configuration -> 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers' section.
steps.expected: The 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers' configuration panel is displayed.

steps.action: Enter test mobile number '9876543210' into the mobile number input field and click 'Save'.
steps.expected: The input is accepted and saved in the configuration list.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner exact field validation criteria (allowed length, accepted country codes, character set restrictions, and duplicate number handling).

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify persistence of configured test mobile numbers across Admin sessions
test_cases.objective: Verify that configured test mobile numbers remain saved in system configuration across user sessions.
preconditions: A test mobile number '9876543210' has been previously saved under 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers'.

steps.action: Log out of the Admin Portal.
steps.expected: Admin session is successfully terminated.

steps.action: Log back into the Admin Portal as Admin and navigate to 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers'.
steps.expected: The configuration page loads successfully.

steps.action: Observe the list of configured test mobile numbers.
steps.expected: The number '9876543210' remains listed.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner whether mobile number validation and formatting persist uniformly without truncation or transformation across sessions.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify state transition upon manual removal of configured test mobile number
test_cases.objective: Verify that manually removing a configured test mobile number transitions its state from configured to unconfigured.
preconditions: Test mobile number '9876543210' exists in 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers' configuration.

steps.action: Navigate to Admin Portal -> 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers'.
steps.expected: The configured list showing '9876543210' is displayed.

steps.action: Click 'Remove' next to mobile number '9876543210' and confirm deletion.
steps.expected: The mobile number is removed from the UI list.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner if removing a number immediately halts background batch processing eligibility and whether audit history of removal is required.

test_cases.feature: Input Validation for Test Mobile Numbers
test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify input validation rules for mobile number formatting and duplicates
test_cases.objective: Verify input validation for length, country code formatting, character sets, and duplicate entry prevention when adding test mobile numbers.
preconditions: Admin user is on 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers' configuration page.

steps.action: Attempt to enter invalid inputs (e.g. short digits '123', special characters 'abc#', duplicate number) into the configuration input field and submit.
steps.expected: System processes the input attempt.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner the missing explicit validation rules including min/max length, accepted country prefixes, and error messages for duplicate numbers.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Execute customer record deletion shell script for configured mobile numbers
test_cases.objective: Verify that the shell script executes and processes deletion for customer records matching configured mobile numbers.
preconditions: Eyewear customer record exists for test mobile number '9876543210'.
Mobile number '9876543210' is listed in Admin configuration.

steps.action: Trigger execution of the customer deletion shell script from server command line interface.
steps.expected: Shell script initiates and completes execution.

steps.action: Query Eyewear database for customer record associated with '9876543210'.
steps.expected: Database query completes.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner whether record deletion is a hard database delete or soft delete, and how child entities (e.g. active carts, saved addresses, auth tokens) are purged.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify success log generation upon successful shell script customer record deletion
test_cases.objective: Verify that the deletion shell script generates a success log entry when customer record deletion completes successfully.
preconditions: Customer record exists for configured mobile number '9876543210'.
Shell script has permissions to write to execution log directory.

steps.action: Execute customer deletion shell script for configured mobile number '9876543210'.
steps.expected: Script completes execution without process errors.

steps.action: Open and inspect the script log output file.
steps.expected: Log entry for mobile number '9876543210' is present.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner the exact log file location, output log schema, level (INFO/SUCCESS), and log retention policy.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify failure log generation when shell script customer deletion encounters error
test_cases.objective: Verify that the customer deletion script generates a failure log entry when an error occurs during execution.
preconditions: Database connectivity error or foreign key violation is simulated for customer deletion process.

steps.action: Trigger execution of customer deletion shell script under simulated database failure condition.
steps.expected: Script encounters error condition during execution.

steps.action: Inspect execution log file.
steps.expected: Failure log entry is recorded.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner failure log detail formatting, error code standard, and target log path/alerting destination.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify scope and strategy of customer deletion on linked database tables
test_cases.objective: Verify whether customer record deletion uses hard delete or soft delete strategy across linked customer tables.
preconditions: Customer profile with linked records (wishlist, cart, addresses) exists for configured test mobile number.

steps.action: Execute customer deletion script.
steps.expected: Script finishes execution.

steps.action: Inspect database tables (customers, carts, user_addresses, auth_tokens) for test mobile number.
steps.expected: Database state reflects deletion action.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner whether relational customer records are hard deleted or soft deleted (is_deleted flag) and if cascading deletes apply to all child entities.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify log storage location, formatting details, and retention policy
test_cases.objective: Verify log storage location, retention duration, log levels, and access controls for customer deletion execution logs.
preconditions: Customer deletion script has completed execution.

steps.action: Check default log destination directory and inspect log file properties.
steps.expected: Log file exists in destination folder.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner designated log file storage path, file naming conventions, rotation/retention period, and access permission requirements.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify daily Cron job execution schedule at 12:30 AM for customer record cleanup
test_cases.objective: Verify that the scheduled Cron job executes automatically at 12:30 AM to delete Eyewear customer records matching configured test mobile numbers.

steps.action: Wait for system clock to reach 12:30 AM or trigger system scheduler mock.

steps.action: Check database for customer record associated with '9876543210'.
steps.expected: Cron job executes deletion logic.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify unconfigured mobile numbers are excluded from deletion during Cron job execution
test_cases.objective: Verify that customer records with mobile numbers not present in Admin configuration are untouched during Cron execution.
preconditions: Customer record exists for unconfigured mobile number '9123456789'.
Mobile number '9123456789' is NOT in 'Auto Delete Customer Mobile Numbers' Admin configuration.

steps.action: Execute scheduled Cron job at 12:30 AM.
steps.expected: Cron job completes execution.

steps.action: Query database for customer record associated with '9123456789'.
steps.expected: Customer record remains unchanged in database.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner timezone details and verify if unconfigured customer accounts are explicitly ignored without generating log warnings.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify retained configured test mobile numbers are processed repeatedly across consecutive nightly Cron runs
test_cases.objective: Verify that test mobile numbers remaining in configuration are processed on each nightly Cron job execution until manually removed.
preconditions: Mobile number '9876543210' is retained in Admin configuration.
A new customer record is created for '9876543210' after initial cleanup.

steps.action: Allow Cron job to execute on consecutive Night 1 and Night 2 at 12:30 AM.

steps.action: Verify database state after each run.
steps.expected: Customer record for '9876543210' is processed on each run.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner execution behavior and timezone handling for repeated nightly cleanups on persistent test accounts.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify timezone specification for 12:30 AM scheduled Cron job execution
test_cases.objective: Verify which specific timezone governs the daily 12:30 AM Cron job execution schedule.
preconditions: Cron job daemon is active on application server.

steps.action: Inspect crontab schedule definition and system timezone configuration.
steps.expected: Cron schedule expression is displayed.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner the exact target timezone (e.g., IST vs UTC vs server local time) for 12:30 AM Cron trigger.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify Cron job logs error and continues batch processing when one record deletion fails
test_cases.objective: Verify fault tolerance of Cron job such that failure in deleting one customer record logs error and continues processing remaining numbers.
preconditions: Multiple mobile numbers ('9876543210', '9876543211', '9876543212') are configured in Admin.
Deletion for '9876543211' is forced to fail (e.g. via mock DB lock/error).

steps.action: Execute scheduled Cron job.
steps.expected: Cron job processes batch.

steps.action: Inspect execution log file.
steps.expected: Error logged for '9876543211'.

steps.action: Verify deletion status of '9876543210' and '9876543212' in database.
steps.expected: Deletion attempted/completed for remaining numbers.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner whether failure notification alerts (email, Slack, webhook) or automatic retry attempts are required for failed records.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify alerting mechanisms and retry policies on Cron job deletion failure
test_cases.objective: Verify system notification behavior and retry logic when mobile number deletion fails during Cron execution.
preconditions: Cron job experiences execution failure for a configured test mobile number.

steps.action: Trigger Cron job execution under partial failure scenario.
steps.expected: Deletion fails for target test number.

steps.action: Check alert channels (monitoring dashboard, email notification, retry queues).
steps.expected: System records failure.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner specific failure alerting mechanisms (e.g. SMTP email alerts, PagerDuty/Slack webhooks) and immediate/next-run retry policies.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify customer record deletion strictly targets and affects Eyewear application database
test_cases.objective: Verify that customer record deletion is strictly contained within Eyewear application databases.

steps.expected: Deletion workflow completes.

steps.action: Query Eyewear database for '9876543210'.
steps.expected: Eyewear customer record is deleted.

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner if SSO token revocation within Eyewear app session storage is required upon deletion.

test_cases.title: Provisional: Verify Tata SSO identities and accounts in other Tata applications remain unchanged during deletion

test_cases.feature: Re-signup Flow with Existing SSO Identity

test_cases.expected_result: REQUIRE SPECIFICATION: Confirm with Product Owner explicit expected flow (automatic account re-creation, profile prompt, or error handling) during re-signup with existing Tata SSO credentials.

test_cases.objective: Verify that configured test mobile numbers are usable by QA for executing signup testing in the Eyewear application.
